description:
Send an APPROVED WhatsApp template message (official Meta API connection only).
This is the ONLY way to message a contact outside the 24-hour customer service
window (24 h since the contact's last message to you); whatsapp_send fails there.
Get the exact template name, language and variables from whatsapp_templates.
`components` follows Meta's format, e.g.
[{ "type": "body", "parameters": [{ "type": "text", "text": "Maria" }] }].
Result: { sent:true, id, delivery:"accepted_by_server" }; follow delivery with
whatsapp_message_status. Meta bills template conversations to the account owner.
name: whatsapp_send_template
